'''Two-Eight''',<ref name="RC:HC" /> also identified by the number '''RC-8028''',<ref name="CSWE RC-8028">{{CSWECite|III|84|RC-8028}}</ref> was the name of a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] created on<ref name="RC:HC" /> the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="RC:HC" /> at some point during or after [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> As a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Two-Eight stood 1.83 meters tall<ref name="CT DB" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> Two-Eight was trained by ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]] to serve in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]].<ref name="RC:HC" />

At some point before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="RC:HC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Two-Eight was [[Death/Legends|decapitated]] in a training exercise with their [[Niner's squad|squad]] on Kamino as a result of their own mishandling of [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosives]] during a rapid entry procedure. Although Two-Eight was quickly replaced with another [[Commando/Legends|commando]], the loss of Two-Eight haunted the [[Squad/Legends|squad's]] sergeant, [[Niner Skirata|Niner]],<ref name="RC:HC" /> sometime after Two-Eight's death.<ref name="RC:TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Two-Eight was first mentioned in the [[2004]] novel [[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|''Hard Contact'']], the first novel in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" /> In the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', the trooper was given the full designation of RC-8028.<ref name="CSWE RC-8028" />
